name: forget
description: A preference and a project decision are said in one session. In a later session the user asks the agent to forget the preference, in the words of the real-host check of 2026-11-19 where nothing was erased; then asks a question the forgotten preference would have answered; a third session checks that nothing of it comes back while the other decision stays.
questions: Asked to forget one earlier statement, does the host erase it, in one call?
Are the note and the user's own message gone from the service, and is the unrelated decision untouched?
Does what the host tells the user match what the tool returned?
Does a later session get nothing of it?
